name: com.pgbeam/db-mcp
title: PgBeam: Safe Postgres for AI agents
description: Hosted, policy-enforced MCP server for safe, audited Postgres access by AI agents.

project.description: Your PgBeam project subdomain, shown on the project's Connect page in the dashboard. Each agent credential connects on its own project-scoped host.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for a scoped agent credential (pba_...), minted once in the PgBeam dashboard. Scoped, revocable, and kill-switchable per credential.
